done_when: Lockfiles and base images are updated within their allowed ranges, the image builds and the test command passes

findings.body: This branch updates the pnpm lockfile, but changes no base-image reference. The supplied close run passes install, lint, typecheck, tests, and the web/API builds; it shows no container-image build. Update the base-image reference within its allowed range and build the image to verify the remaining acceptance criteria.

why: Dependencies and base images are over a week old, so new security advisories fail the image scan
